_about: Théodule Ribot (1839-1916), founder of French scientific psychology, in English: The Psychology of the Emotions (London: Walter Scott, 1897; clean Gutenberg text, translator unnamed), and raw IA OCR of Diseases of Memory, tr. William Huntington Smith (New York: Appleton, 1887), The Psychology of Attention, authorised translation, 5th revised ed. (Chicago: Open Court, 1903), and The Diseases of the Will, tr. Merwin-Marie Snell, 4th enlarged English ed. (Open Court, 1915). Added in round am: Heredity: a psychological study of its phenomena, laws, causes and consequences (New York: D. Appleton, 1875). Added in round am: English Psychology (New York: D. Appleton, 1874). Added in round am: The Diseases of Personality (New York, copyright 1887 by J. Fitzgerald), tr. J. Fitzgerald. US public domain.
